is_anopheles.evidence: Studies Anopheles gambiae complex mosquitoes (Anopheles gambiae s.s. and Anopheles coluzzii) collected in Freetown, Sierra Leone and Monrovia, Liberia (page 1, Abstract; page 2, Specimen Collection).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Reports genotyping of Vgsc L995F (kdr / 1014F) using the Martinez-Torres et al. (1998) method (page 2, 'Molecular Studies'; page 4, Table 2 and text discussing the '1014F kdr allele').

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 2 gives exact genotype counts and percentages (RR, SS, RS) for An. coluzzii and An. gambiae s.s across five communities in Freetown (page 4, Table 2).

african_field_population.evidence: Adult mosquitoes were collected indoors from households in Freetown, Sierra Leone in November–December 2009 using the pyrethrum spray catch method (pages 1-2, 'Study Sites').

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary research study reporting original field collections and PCR-based species and resistance marker genotyping.

sub_country_location.evidence: Communities within Freetown, Sierra Leone: Aberdeen, Gbedembu, George Brook, Kissi (Kissy), and York (page 4, Table 2).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collections in Freetown, Sierra Leone took place in November–December 2009 (page 1, 'Study Sites').

duplicate_risk.evidence: Original field survey conducted in 2009/2011 by the authors.

supplement.evidence: All genotype data are provided directly in Table 2 of the main text.

assessment.summary: This study surveyed Anopheles gambiae s.l. sibling species and Vgsc L995F (kdr 1014F) in Freetown, Sierra Leone, along with species composition in Monrovia, Liberia. A total of 182 An. gambiae s.l. (67 An. coluzzii and 115 An. gambiae s.s.) from 5 communities in Freetown were genotyped for L995F, revealing very high frequencies of the resistant allele.
